result: Hardened partial-prefix and unsuccessful-Ok semantics for ProductionSolver and SwitchingSolution. Documented Ok-result semantics and added solve_checked, is_successful_endpoint, and ensure_completed. All 7 tests in production_contracts passed.
limitations: Overall qualification verdict remains HOLD_NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED until all qualification tasks complete.
Global error theorem across full non-smooth hybrid space requires subsequent qualification tasks.

math_review.definitions: An accepted prefix on [t0, t_final] with t_final < t1 is a strictly partial solution. Ok(solution) with success == false preserves the partial accepted trajectory and all work counters.
assumptions: Local error estimates do not guarantee global error certificates on early exits
All callback invocations, speculative attempts, and factorizations are charged deterministically
math_review.derivation: Checked outcome semantics enforce that solve_checked returns Ok only when both success == true and accounting_complete == true, returning typed error Err(ProductionSolveError::Unsuccessful) otherwise.
math_review.roundoff_model: Exact floating point comparisons for endpoints and bit-level conservation.

decision_rationale: Task API-001 implementation completed with 100% test pass, zero-allocation compliance, rustfmt pass, and git diff check pass. Overall verdict remains hold per task specification.
